_: THE COMMERCIAL MODEL — one qualification, three routes, one price logic.
data/tuition.json decomposes ONE level fee for ONE route. This file
holds everything else the College charges or remits, and it exists for
the same reason: a figure typed onto a page drifts, and a figure
computed from a weight cannot.
THE PRINCIPLE THE WHOLE MODEL RESTS ON
You pay for what the College DOES for you. You never pay for the
credential itself, and the credential is the same whichever route
you take to it: same examination, same rubric, same second marking,
same internal moderation, same registry entry, same verification.
That is why the routes may differ in price by a factor of five and
still be honest. What the enrolled student buys that the independent
candidate does not is TEACHING — a named instructor, written feedback
on every piece of produced work, tutorials, advising and support. What
they both buy is the assessment and the award.
WHY THE INDEPENDENT FEES ARE NOT THE ENROLLED COST-SHARE
tuition.json allocates 15% of a level fee to 'Assessment and marking'
— $475 — and the independent assessment fee is $250. That is not a
discount and not an inconsistency: the two buy different things. The
enrolled line covers ten module quizzes, ten assignments marked with
written feedback by a person, the level examination and its second
marking. The independent fee covers the level examination, its second
marking and its internal moderation. Marking ten assignments with
feedback is teaching; it is priced where teaching is priced.
The same reasoning holds for materials. Authoring a curriculum is a
fixed cost the enrolled fees carry; supplying it to one more reader
costs almost nothing, and the College charges $150 rather than the
$348 cost-share because charging a marginal reader an average cost is
how an institution prices itself out of its own mission.
WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT HERE
No cash commission, anywhere. No fee for sitting again. No fee for
the certificate an enrolled student earns. No negotiated partner rate
— the bands below are published, so an institution that asks for a
price gets the same answer as one that does not know to ask.

enrolled._: The default. Priced in data/tuition.json and decomposed there.

_: For a candidate who wants the qualification without the teaching.
Unbundled into the three things the College actually performs:
supply the material, assess the work, confer and record the award.
Each is bought separately and each stands alone — a candidate may
buy the materials and never sit, or sit and never take the award,
and the College does not require the next step to sell the last.

en.name: The level's materials
en.buys: Every authored lesson of the level, its workbook, its listening scripts, its pronunciation targets and its self-checks — downloadable, permanent, and yours to print. The same material an enrolled student studies.

ar.name: مواد المستوى
ar.buys: كل درس مؤلَّف في المستوى، وكتاب تدريباته، ونصوص استماعه، وأهداف نطقه، ومراجعاته الذاتية — قابلة للتنزيل، دائمة، ولك أن تطبعها. وهي المادة نفسها التي يدرسها الملتحق.

en.name: The level examination
en.buys: The same examination an enrolled candidate sits, marked by a person against the same published rubric, second-marked, and put through the same internal moderation. One re-sit is included; there is no re-sit fee on either route.

ar.name: امتحان المستوى
ar.buys: الامتحان نفسه الذي يؤدّيه الملتحق، يصححه شخص وفق المعيار المنشور نفسه، ويُصحَّح ثانيةً، ويمر بالتعديل الداخلي نفسه. وتدخل فيه إعادة واحدة؛ ولا رسم إعادة في أي من المسارين.

en.name: The award and its record
en.buys: The award itself: the digital certificate, the signature on it, your entry in the registry, the transcript, and verification by anyone, without an account, for as long as the College exists.

ar.name: الشهادة وسجلها
ar.buys: الشهادة نفسها: المستند الرقمي، والتوقيع عليه، وقيدك في السجل، وكشف الدرجات، وتحقّقٌ يجريه أي أحد بلا حساب ما دامت الكلية قائمة.

_no_conferral_fee_for_enrolled: The conferral step is the one that has to be explained, because
the tuition page promises an enrolled student 'no graduation fee'
and means it. An enrolled student pays nothing to be awarded:
certification is line 8 of their level fee. The independent
candidate has not paid that line, so they pay it here. Both pages
say so, and each links to the other — an unexplained fee on one
page and a promise it does not exist on another is how a fee

_: An institution enrolling a group — a school, an employer, a
ministry. Published bands rather than a negotiated rate, because
a price that depends on who asks is a price the College cannot
defend, and the buyer with the least leverage is always the one
who needed the help most.
conditions_en: The band applies to tuition. It never applies to an assessment standard, a pass mark or a moderation step.
A sponsor sees a student's progress only with that student's written consent, given separately from the sponsorship and withdrawable at any time. The record belongs to the student.
A sponsored student who leaves the sponsor keeps the place and the record. The seat is bought; the person is not.
The refund window is the student's, not the sponsor's, and runs from the student's own start.
conditions_ar: تنطبق الشريحة على الرسوم الدراسية. ولا تنطبق أبدًا على معيار تقييم ولا درجة نجاح ولا خطوة تعديل.
لا يرى الراعي تقدّم الطالب إلا بموافقة خطية من الطالب نفسه، تُعطى منفصلة عن الرعاية ويجوز سحبها في أي وقت. فالسجل ملك الطالب.
الطالب المكفول الذي يترك راعيه يحتفظ بمقعده وبسجله. فالمقعد يُشترى، أما الشخص فلا.
نافذة الاسترداد للطالب لا للراعي، وتبدأ من تاريخ بدئه هو.

_: THE FOUNDATION REMISSION — a scholarship scheme that cannot be
announced and then not funded.
The College's own page said, correctly, that publishing criteria it
could not fund would be worse than publishing nothing. The way out
is not to promise a sum; it is to make the fund a RULE rather than
a figure. Five per cent of every dollar of tuition received is
placed in the remission fund. The fund therefore exists exactly
when tuition does, cannot be overspent, and needs no capital the
College does not have.
One consequence, stated plainly on the page: in a term with little
tuition there is little remission. A scheme that scales with what
the College takes is honest about its own size in a way a fixed
promise is not.
award_kinds_en: Full remission of a level fee
Partial remission, stated as a percentage

en.name: Financial need
en.test: Household circumstances as stated by the applicant, with one supporting document where one exists. The College does not require documents a candidate in hardship cannot obtain, and says so rather than quietly rejecting them.

ar.name: الحاجة المالية
ar.test: ظروف الأسرة كما يذكرها المتقدم، مع مستند مؤيد واحد إن وُجد. ولا تطلب الكلية مستندات يعجز عن استخراجها من هو في ضائقة، وتقول ذلك صراحةً بدل أن ترفضه بصمت.

en.name: Academic promise
en.test: The placement assessment already taken, and a written statement of 300 words on what command of English would change for the applicant. Marked against a published descriptor, not an impression.

ar.name: الوعد الأكاديمي
ar.test: تقييم تحديد المستوى المؤدَّى أصلًا، وبيان مكتوب في ثلاثمئة كلمة عمّا سيغيّره إتقان الإنجليزية في حياة المتقدم. يُقيَّم وفق وصف منشور لا وفق انطباع.

decision_chain_en: Applications are received by the Registrar, who holds student records and confirms eligibility.
A panel of three assesses them: the Registrar, the Director of Student Success on need, and the Dean of Academic Affairs on promise.
The panel's decisions are minuted with the score against each criterion. Every applicant is told the outcome, including those who are not awarded.
The Governor for Finance and Audit receives the round's report and may audit any decision in it.
decision_chain_ar: يتلقّى الطلبات مسجّل الكلية، وهو من يحفظ سجلات الطلاب ويتحقق من الاستحقاق.
وتنظر فيها لجنة ثلاثية: مسجّل الكلية، ومديرة نجاح الطلاب في باب الحاجة، وعميد الشؤون الأكاديمية في باب الوعد الأكاديمي.
وتُثبَّت قرارات اللجنة في محضر مع درجة كل معيار. ويُبلَّغ كل متقدم بالنتيجة، بمن فيهم من لم يُمنح.
وتتلقى عضوة مجلس الأمناء للمالية والمراجعة تقرير الدورة، ولها أن تراجع أي قرار فيه.
remission.round_en: A round opens with each cohort, closes fourteen days before that cohort begins, and is decided within fourteen days of closing.
remission.round_ar: تُفتح دورة مع كل دفعة، وتُغلق قبل بدء الدفعة بأربعة عشر يومًا، ويُبتّ فيها خلال أربعة عشر يومًا من إغلاقها.
remission.status_en: Adopted 17 August 2026. The first round opens with the next cohort; none has run, and no remission has been awarded to anyone.
remission.status_ar: اعتُمِد في ١٧ أغسطس ٢٠٢٦. وتُفتح الدورة الأولى مع الدفعة القادمة؛ ولم تجرِ دورة بعد، ولم يُمنح إعفاء لأحد.

_: A remission, never a commission. The moment a person is paid cash
for bringing the College a student, that person has an interest in
what they say about it, and the College has bought a salesperson it
cannot supervise. So the benefit is a credit against the referrer's
own next fee, it is capped, and it settles only after the referred
student's refund window has closed — so nobody profits from a
student who leaves in the first fortnight.
referral.usable_against_en: Any fee the referrer owes the College — an enrolled level fee, or any step of the independent route.
referral.usable_against_ar: أي رسم يستحق على المُحيل للكلية — رسم مستوى للملتحق، أو أي خطوة من خطوات المسار المستقل.
rules_en: Paid as a credit, never as cash, and never to anyone who is not a student or an award-holder of the College.
Applied to one fee at a time and never beyond it. Anything left over carries to your next fee, and is never paid out.
Three per person across the whole programme. A cap is what separates a thank-you from a job.
Settled fourteen days after the referred student starts, when their refund window has closed.
Not payable on yourself, on a person already in the admissions record, or on a sponsored seat bought under a partner band.
rules_ar: تُدفع رصيدًا لا نقدًا، ولا تُدفع أبدًا لمن ليس طالبًا في الكلية ولا حاملًا لشهادة منها.
يُطبَّق على رسم واحد في المرة ولا يتجاوزه. وما بقي منه يُرحَّل إلى رسمك التالي، ولا يُدفَع نقدًا أبدًا.
ثلاث إحالات للشخص الواحد في البرنامج كله. والحدّ هو ما يفصل الشكر عن الوظيفة.
تُسوّى بعد أربعة عشر يومًا من بدء الطالب المُحال، حين تُغلق نافذة استرداده.
ولا تُستحق على نفسك، ولا على شخص مقيَّد في سجل القبول أصلًا، ولا على مقعد مكفول ضمن شريحة شراكة.

_: The honest finding, and it is worth stating rather than dressing:
almost everything a college normally sells its alumni, this one
already gives away. The Library is free to anyone. Verification is
free to anyone. Digital certificates and transcripts are reissued
free, for life, to the person they belong to. There is no discount
to invent that would not be an admission the first fee was too
high.
What an award-holder gets that a stranger does not is STANDING:
the right to take a further level without re-enrolling, the
referral credit usable against it, and a place in the register if
they want one.

standings_en.name: The independent route, without re-enrolling
standings_en.what: An award-holder may take any later level by the independent route at the published step fees, without applying again. The placement already stands.

standings_en.name: The referral credit, usable either way
standings_en.what: An award-holder who refers a candidate receives the same $250 credit, and may set it against an independent-route fee rather than tuition.

standings_en.name: The register, by choice
standings_en.what: A public roll of award-holders, for anyone wanting to confirm a person rather than a document. Appearing in it is the graduate's decision, not a consequence of graduating.

standings_en.name: Everything else, already free
standings_en.what: Every Library volume, every verification check, and every reissue of a certificate or transcript — free to alumni because they are free to everyone.

standings_ar.name: المسار المستقل، بلا التحاق جديد
standings_ar.what: لحامل الشهادة أن يأخذ أي مستوى لاحق بالمسار المستقل بالرسوم المنشورة، دون تقديم طلب جديد. فتحديد مستواه قائم.

standings_ar.name: رصيد الإحالة، صالح في المسارين
standings_ar.what: حامل الشهادة الذي يُحيل مرشحًا يأخذ الرصيد نفسه، وله أن يضعه مقابل رسم في المسار المستقل بدل الرسوم الدراسية.

standings_ar.name: السجل، بالاختيار
standings_ar.what: سجل عام بحملة الشهادات، لمن أراد أن يتثبّت من شخص لا من مستند. والظهور فيه قرار الخريج، لا نتيجة تلقائية لتخرجه.

standings_ar.name: وما عدا ذلك، مجاني أصلًا
standings_ar.what: كل مجلد في المكتبة، وكل عملية تحقق، وكل إعادة إصدار لشهادة أو كشف درجات — مجانية للخريجين لأنها مجانية للجميع.
